'Manage yer crew!' in the town menu; press C at sea to see who you have.

events.body: Your master gunner asks leave to exercise the great guns. 'Powder and time, Captain, that's all it costs. They'll be faster for it when it counts.'

options.text: Beat to quarters and run them out.
options.outcome: The deck shakes with dry runs until sundown. The men are hoarse and pleased with themselves.
He touches his hat and goes below, disappointed.

events.body: Your quartermaster has been going through the last prize's papers. A false bottom in the master's sea chest, he says, and something inside it.

options.outcome: Two hundred in good coin. He makes a careful note of it in the articles, as a quartermaster should.

options.text: Share it out among the men now.
options.outcome: It goes round the mess tables before supper. Nobody grumbles that night.

events.body: The surgeon has been making his rounds below. Scurvy is starting in the forecastle, he reports, but it is early, and he knows what to do about it.

options.outcome: Limes and sauerkraut from the stores, and a surgeon's temper with anyone who will not eat them. It goes no further.
It does not keep. Two men are too weak to work by the time you make land.

events.body: Your sailing master taps the chart. 'There's a passage through the shoals here that most captains won't risk. I've run it before.'

options.outcome: He takes her through with a hand on the lead line and never raises his voice. The men watch him with new respect.
The long way it is. He shrugs; it is your ship.
